page.title: Imprint Random Walk NFT
page.subtitle: Own a Random Walk NFT and receive a 50% reduction in ETH Gesture Cost
page.description: Each Random Walk NFT can reduce the ETH Gesture Cost of one gesture by 50%. Choose an unused NFT when making an ETH gesture to apply the reduction. This one-time use is separate from anchoring Random Walk NFTs for Anchored-NFT Stellar Selection eligibility.

seo.heading: Imprint Random Walk NFT
seo.description: Imprint a Random Walk NFT to use with Cosmic Signature. Each unused NFT can be attached to one ETH gesture for a 50% Gesture Cost reduction.
seo.source: Cosmic Signature public protocol configuration APIs
